backend-app.description: A NestJS app in apps/<name>, set up like apps/sales-api.

backend-lib.description: An empty Nest lib in packages/backend/<name>, registered in a backend app.

backend-resource.description: Contract, Drizzle table and Nest lib (module, service, controller) of a resource.

contract.description: Request schemas and response types in packages/contracts.

frontend-lib.description: An empty frontend lib in packages/frontend/<name> (TypeScript sources), registered in apps/sales-web.

frontend-app.description: A Next.js app in apps/<name>, set up like apps/sales-web: sign-in, account and an empty dashboard.

frontend-resource.description: The pages of a resource in a frontend app: data, actions, list, detail, form and the sidebar link, synced with the contract.

frontend-data.description: lib/<plural>.ts (API types and fetchers) and lib/<plural>-table.ts (table config) of a resource.

frontend-actions.description: Server actions (save, delete), the form schema and the delete confirmation of a resource.

frontend-list.description: The list page of a resource: the table, its columns and row actions.

frontend-detail.description: The detail page of a resource ([id]), its loader and the <singular>-detail component.

frontend-form.description: The create/edit form of a resource, with the new and [id]/edit pages.

frontend-nav.description: A resource's link in the sidebar (lib/navigation.ts).

remove-backend-db-column.description: Removes columns (or relations) from a Drizzle table, then syncs the contract, the service and their specs.

frontend-resource-sync.description: Brings the pages of a resource (form, list, detail) in line with its contract: adds the fields it lacks, removes those the contract dropped.

contract-sync.description: Brings a resource's contract in line with its table, then the service's queries and the specs' sample bodies.
